author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand sits down with identity and transformation expert Jamie Winship to unpack what may be the most misunderstood teaching Jesus ever offered humanity — that we are enough. Drawing on the story of Elijah standing alone in battle Jamie and Russell explore the profound idea that every person is wired into God's circuitry and carries within them the capacity to bring change, do good and resist the forces of darkness in the world. Russell reflects on how the systems and empires of this world deliberately make people feel small, powerless and insufficient and why reclaiming the truth that we are enough is one of the most radical and transformative acts of faith a person can make.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand reacts to the deeply troubling case of a deaf man in the UK who was arrested and charged with a hate crime after asking someone to speak English — completely unaware that the person had been attempting to speak to him in a language he could not hear. Russell uses the case to expose what he sees as the complete collapse of integrity and common sense within UK policing where officers prioritise woke ideology over genuine public safety and the protection of innocent citizens. A devastating example of how far British law enforcement has strayed from its actual purpose.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand reacts to the ongoing chaos surrounding the Strait of Hormuz opening and closing and opening again and cannot hide his disbelief at how absurd and cartoonish modern news has become. Russell argues that tuning into the news today feels less like following world events and more like watching a children's cartoon where nothing makes sense and the madness never stops. In the middle of it all Russell makes a powerful case that only Christ can cut through the noise and confusion of the modern world and offer the clarity and peace that no news cycle ever could.
